## Description

<!-- description:start -->

<p>Find two numbers that add up to <code>target</code>.</p>

## Solutions

<!-- solution:start -->

### Solution 1: Hash Table

<!-- thinking:start -->

> **Thinking**
>
> Checking every pair is quadratic.
>
> A hash table finds the complement in constant time.

<!-- thinking:end -->

Store each number's index in a hash table.

The time complexity is $O(n)$.
